text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the dance
studio...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
H-hiya guys! ♪ Your one and only El is
back in
action! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's missing something! I need a little more oomph! Like I'm bringing the world right to your doorstep!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So you're hopping on that whole
"world"
shtick too, eh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ack! Who's there?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you, Golshi. What are you
doing
here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? I'm here because you're
throwing
the word "world" around like
it's a sack of
potatoes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
H-how am I throwing it around?! I'm
serious about
aiming to be the world's
strongest! I mean it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest, huh? Not sure
about that
one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You talk the talk,
but I don't see a lot of
walking.
I sense hesitation. You're lost.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: W-well...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's got you rackin' your brains, hm?
Lay it on
me! You afraid of the world?!
HUH?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! If I'm running,
I'm not losing! Doesn't
matter
where in the world or with who!
But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My performances are nothing like
Pearl's... So I
started thinking just
maybe, they're not
world-class yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, cut that out. You're acting like a
piece of grilled fish at the
supermarket—letting someone
else do
all the cooking.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're nothing like Pearl? Or the
others? Gimme
that spatula so I can flip
you out!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nobody else matters! You've gotta bring
out your
own flavors! Spice yourself up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: M-my own flavors?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! What you're lacking is your
own
unique flavor! Give me some umami!
Sprinkle on
those bonito flakes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! Yeah, the trainer
secretly
watching us from the shadows!
You agree with
me, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect to be thrown into the
spotlight
suddenly. What should I say
here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect to be thrown into the
spotlight
suddenly. What should I say
here...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Original flavor...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You might have a point... In wanting to
be like
someone else, I lost sight of
myself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If anything, I should be showering everyone in my colors! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna reflect on myself and find my
own way
of doing things!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now you get it. What do you think

crustaceans use their pincers for? To
crab their
dreams.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I should know what my own
flavors are.
What makes me unique...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...is how I pack the heat!
I've got passion,
spunk,
and vitality!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If the recipe I'm using doesn't show off
those
flavors, what's the point?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, I need to come up with a
performance
that's really all about me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I like that spark in your eyes... You
better
come back as the king of the
deep seas one of
these days.
